title: Risk Reviews, Suspension and Closure of a Pocketwire Business Profile
content:
## Reviews

Reviews of a Pocketwire Business Profile are started by the risk system for a sales-limit excess or a chargeback ratio above the tier's threshold, and for identity or prohibited-goods reports. A review pauses payouts while sales continue.

A review is cleared only on a review documents request whose request status is approved by the review team; the request record is the evidence. The review team decides submitted review documents within the tier's review decision target in business days, and a representative cannot shorten or pre-empt that decision.

## Suspension

A profile is suspended when the review team declined the review documents request, or when no review documents request was submitted and the response window has passed: the suspension is recorded later than the tier's review document window in calendar days after the review start time. The window is counted in calendar days from the review start time, the day after the review started being day 1, and the window is still open on its last day. A suspended profile can no longer accept payments.

**Boundary days (hypothetical window of 10 days, review started on the 5th, no request submitted):** on the 15th (day 10) the window is still open and no suspension is recorded; from the 16th the window has passed.

## Closing

A suspended profile's balance stays until open claims close and holds are released; it is then paid out to the owner's personal balance by a support representative and the profile is closed. A suspended profile is closed when its balance is zero and no claim is open.

The owner may close an active profile only when its business balance is 0.00, no buyer claim is open and no hold is unreleased. Closing is the owner's own decision, confirmed in the app.

| Profile | Closed by | Conditions |
|---|---|---|
| active | the owner, in the app | balance 0.00, no open buyer claim, no unreleased hold |
| suspended | a support representative | balance paid out to the owner's personal balance once claims have closed and holds are released; zero balance and no open claim |
